method.reason_no_new_oracle_pass: This follow-up narrows only to the four already-frozen decisive links and does not alter the scoring, admission rule, or target theory.

new_high_value_findings.textual_function: The formula explicitly gives the heart of the Osiris N back to him in the underworld, followed by first-person ownership claims: the heart, chest, mouth, legs and arms are his/mine.
A divine helper says that Osiris's bones are united, limbs assembled, heart brought and placed at its proper place in the body.

A secret formula is described as given from father to son, placed physically on a linen carrier at the deceased's neck, able to raise the deceased, join him to Horus's following and make his body divine. The text also attributes the act to Thoth for an Osirian royal recipient.
why_rejected_as_full_hit: generic reproducible ritual carrier rather than unique original body component
father-to-son lineage transfer is an AURA false-positive trap for future-actor selection
no statement that Osiris left the item himself

new_high_value_findings.source: Papyrus Chester Beatty IV, The Immortality of the Writer
new_high_value_findings.textual_function: Writings and teachings become heirs when biological descendants fail; the text says the offspring of others can function as heirs and that powers were hidden in teachings to be read later.
why_hot: future readers receive what biological heirs do not
why_rejected_as_full_hit: the preserved medium is writing/knowledge, not a unique original Osirian component

new_high_value_findings.textual_function: The teaching is useful to whoever heeds, condemns greed and taking what is not one's due, and states that people teach by deeds and transmit conduct onward.
why_rejected_as_full_hit: no explicit delayed future finder tied to an object
composition is framed as father-to-son teaching even though it generalizes to whoever heeds

negative_controls_strengthened.source: Heart scarabs / Book of the Dead 30 tradition
negative_controls_strengthened.control: UCL explicitly notes that heart scarabs did not replace the heart in the mummy, despite a common modern claim.
negative_controls_strengthened.meaning: Do not manufacture an ORIGINAL_VS_SUBSTITUTE hit from heart-scarab practice.

negative_controls_strengthened.control: A substitute agent can perform labor for the deceased, but this is delegated function rather than preservation of unique owner identity.

dead_side: OWNER-SPECIFIC BODY PART CAN BE GIVEN BACK
COMPONENTS CAN BE ASSEMBLED AND PLACED BACK IN BODY
SECRET PHYSICAL RITUAL CARRIER CAN ENABLE RAISING/TRANSFIGURATION
living_side: KNOWLEDGE/POWERS CAN BE INTENTIONALLY PRESERVED FOR FUTURE NON-BLOODLINE READERS
GREED AND TAKING WHAT IS NOT DUE ARE CONDEMNED
cross_book_alignment_v2.modern_join: SECRET RETURN-ENABLING MECHANIC + FUTURE NON-BLOODLINE TRANSMISSION + NON-POSSESSION ETHIC

verdict.most_important_new_observation: BD101 and Chester Beatty IV form a striking cross-corpus near-miss: one side preserves a secret physical resurrection/transfiguration procedure; the other explicitly preserves powers/teachings for future heirs beyond bloodline. The complete theory still requires a unique original component and artifact-specific non-possession/owner-return linkage.
do_not_claim: that Osiris intentionally left his phallus as a return key
that any museum object is the literal original member
that a supernatural return mechanism is empirically established

next_gate.rule: Do not score generic resurrection, generic amulets, generic future readers, generic generosity, or generic body restoration as decisive evidence.
